llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅报告临床手术入路的早期效果，不涉及髋关节假体的生物力学分析或应力遮挡评估。
llm.why_not_core: This paper reports clinical outcomes of a surgical approach, with no finite element analysis, stress shielding quantification, or micromotion modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较直接前入路与后入路全髋置换的早期疗效差异。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性临床研究，分析两组患者术后功能评分与并发症。
summary_zh.result: 直接前入路组早期功能恢复更优但学习曲线较长。
summary_zh.validation: 基于患者临床随访数据统计比较。

summary_en.motivation: To compare early clinical outcomes between direct anterior and posterior approaches in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective clinical study analyzing postoperative functional scores and complication rates.
summary_en.result: The direct anterior approach group showed superior early functional recovery but a longer learning curve.
summary_en.validation: Based on statistical comparison of patient follow-up data.

papers.title: Biomaterials for pluripotent stem cell engineering: From fate determination to vascularization.
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in material science and engineering may hold the key to overcoming reproducibility and scalability limitations currently hindering the clinical translation of stem cell therapies. Biomaterial assisted differentiation commitment of stem cells and modulation of their in vivo function could have significant impact in stem cell-centred regenerative medicine approaches and next gen technological platforms. Synthetic biomaterials are of particular interest as they provide a consistent, chemically defined, and tunable way of mimicking the physical and chemical properties of the natural tissue or cell environment. Combining emerging biomaterial and biofabrication advancements may finally give researchers the tools to modulate spatiotemporal complexity and engineer more hierarchically complex, physiologically relevant tissue mimics. In this review we highlight recent research advancements in biomaterial assisted pluripotent stem cell (PSC) expansion and three dimensional (3D) tissue formation strategies. Furthermore, since vascularization is a major challenge affecting the in vivo function of engineered tissues, we discuss recent developments in vascularization strategies and assess their ability to produce perfusable and functional vasculature that can be integrated with the host tissue.

llm.why_not_core: This paper is a pure biomaterials and stem cell biology review with no mention of AI, machine learning, or bioprinting, thus completely off-topic for AI-driven bioprinting.

summary_zh.method: 回顾近年生物材料辅助干细胞扩增、3D组织形成及血管化策略。
summary_zh.result: 指出生物材料与生物制造结合可构建复杂组织类似物。

summary_en.motivation: To review how biomaterials can direct pluripotent stem cell fate and enable vascularization for tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: Survey recent advances in biomaterial-assisted stem cell expansion, 3D tissue formation, and vascularization strategies.
summary_en.result: Combining biomaterials with biofabrication offers tools for constructing physiologically relevant tissue mimics.
